key.name: driver
key.description: agent: a liquid-glass sphere rests in the bottom-left corner and zips through commands; the mouse stirs nothing. pointer: the effect follows the mouse pointer (see Style).

key.name: agent-look
key.description: island: a glowing pill under the top bar, joined to a light along the edge; commands fly out of it as a droplet. ring: a ring of liquid glass swirling inside an invisible circle (spins up while a command runs). orb: a morphing glass orb.

key.name: orb-size
key.description: Diameter of the agent's glass orb in pixels.

key.name: orb-home
key.description: Fractions (x, y) of the work area where the orb was last dropped; negative = the bottom-left corner.

key.name: orb-motion
key.summary: Animate the orb while it rests
key.description: When on, the resting orb slowly morphs and tumbles (redraws the screen ~30 times a second). When off, it holds still until a command runs.

key.name: style
key.description: lens: a small liquid-glass lens follows the pointer. water: the pointer drags ripples through the screen.

key.name: lens-size
key.description: Diameter of the lens in pixels (about one desktop icon by default).

key.name: lens-zoom
key.description: Magnification at the centre of the lens.

key.name: cover-everything
key.description: When on, windows, their contents, the top bar and the dock bend too. When off, only the wallpaper does, and only while the pointer is over the desktop.

key.name: wake-width
key.description: Width of the wake and ripple fronts, in pixels.

key.name: distortion
key.description: How strongly things bend under the water (up to 20 px at 1).

key.name: ripple-life
key.description: Seconds a ripple keeps travelling before it has faded out (lower = more damping).

key.name: active-radius
key.description: How far the water reaches around each point of the pointer's trail (fast moves reach further, slow ones less).

key.name: highlights
key.description: Brightness of the thin glossy lines on the ripples.
